head: Amazon's Android Alexa Tablets get first price cuts before Black Friday
dek: Amazon's Alexa Tablets, which replaced Fire tablets in October and run Android with the Google Play Store, were on sale in the US on 19 November: the Alexa Tablet 8 for $149.99 instead of $229.99 and the Alexa Tablet 11 for $219.99 instead of $329.99.
